verdict.rationale: Cognee documents an explicit session-memory model keyed by (user_id, session_id) that stores an ordered list of recent interactions, plus `.improve()` explicitly described for use 'at the end of a chat or agent session to bridge short-term session memory into permanent memory,' and `.recall()` for retrieving relevant memory afterward — directly enabling an agent to resume from prior context. However, there is no explicit 'summarization' step described (e.g., condensing a session into a digest) and no independent/hands-on evidence of cross-session recall quality beyond docs claims. Missing for 10: evidence of an explicit summary-generation feature and third-party validation that recalled session context is accurate/usable in practice.
